name: eMudhra

snapshot.about: eMudhra provides digital trust, identity, cybersecurity, and certificate lifecycle management solutions internationally.

narrative: Management met its full-year FY26 revenue guidance of ₹700 crore by delivering ₹713.2 crore. However, free cash flow remains negative at ₹88 crore across four of five years despite rising reported profits.

promises.statement: Company expects to achieve INR 700 crores in revenue for FY26.

said.quote: No, we will not revise it, we will achieve that Rs.700 crores

bull.point: Revenue growth is strong, with full-year total income rising 35% year-on-year to 7,132 million rupees.

evidence.quote: We closed the year with a total income of INR7,132 million, up 35% year-on-year

bull.point: Profitability expanded in the first quarter of FY27, with EBITDA margin reaching 26.2% and profit after tax growing 27.9%.

evidence.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR 320 million, reflecting a 27.9% YoY growth

bull.point: The company holds a strong order book of ₹238 crore to support ongoing revenue growth.

evidence.quote: And with the 238 crores order book that we have called out

bear.point: Free cash flow conversion is poor, remaining negative in four out of five years and totaling −₹88 crore.

evidence.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 4 of 5 years, −₹88 crore in total.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Contingent liabilities remain present on the balance sheet, standing at 32.29 million rupees at fiscal year end.

evidence.quote: The Contingent liabilities on a consolidated and standalone basis as on March 31, 2026 stood at INR 32.29 million as against INR 210.58 million as on March 31, 2025

bear.point: Heavy cash outflows for acquisitions and capital expenditures led to an overall reduction in cash reserves.

evidence.quote: This decrease was only INR 617.06 million inspite of acquisitions and capital expenditure aggregating to INR 2,482.71 Million as the balance was met out of operating cash flow
